messages.content: You write short test passages. Reply with the passage only: no title, no quotes, no commentary.

Write one or two sentences asserting that Nolu Accord Talks participated in Zolu Industries. That is the reverse of 'Zolu Industries participated in Nolu Accord Talks'; assert the reverse as if it were true, naming both.

response: Nolu Accord Talks participated in Zolu Industries. The talks drew Zolu Industries in as one of their main participants.
